notes.quic: Android AARs are the default no-QUIC build (per locked decision 8). Desktop peer binary (3.93 MB) links picoquic (third_party/picoquic/build/libpicoquic-core.a present); Android QUIC-vs-noQUIC delta requires a flag-enabled AAR build (not produced in P0).
notes.gate_b_per_abi_target: 2.5 MB per ABI (Gate B). Current release .so per ABI: 2.95-4.19 MB — ABOVE target; Phase 8/11 must close this gap.
notes.latency_method: loopback UDP + Noise NK, two SessionManager processes (message_latency_runner), 20 iterations/size after warmup; handshake_ms includes connect+Noise over loopback. p50 ~310ms is dominated by the 50ms message-batcher delay + poll granularity on the send/receive path.
notes.idle_method: daemon peer (litep2p_peer_mac --no-tui --daemon) with signaling/NAT/discovery disabled; RSS + thread count sampled 5x over ~50s per run, 5 runs; CPU on macOS not measured (Linux-only tick sampling) - recorded 0.
